bands.blurb: Limited machine-readable signal beyond documentation a human can read.

providers.name: Marriott International
providers.description: Marriott International is the world's largest hotel group by room count, headquartered in Bethesda, Maryland, United States, operating and franchising roughly thirty brands from The Ritz-Carlton, St. Regis and W through Marriott Hotels, Sheraton, Westin and Courtyard down to Fairfield, Moxy and StudioRes, plus the Homes & Villas by Marriott Bonvoy home-rental marketplace and the Marriott Bonvoy loyalty program. It sits on the supply side of the travel distribution chain: it publishes rates and availability into every major global distribution system — Marriott's own travel-agent site states it "participates in the following GDS: Amadeus, Sabre, Travelport (Apollo/Galileo, and Worldspan)" — sells through the OTAs, connects short-term-rental supply through a channel-connectivity partner program, and spends heavily to pull demand back to direct booking on Marriott.com and the Bonvoy app. Its API posture is closed. A Broadcom Layer7 developer portal exists at devportalprod.marriott.com and returns HTTP 200, but its anonymous API catalog is literally empty and the portal's own home content returns HTTP 401 — there is no self-serve signup, no public API reference, no published rates/availability/booking API, no sandbox, no SDK, no changelog and no exit path. The only Marriott OpenAPI documents that can be read without a contract are eight internal and partner-facing specifications left publicly readable on SwaggerHub under the "marriott-api" owner; six are mirrored here verbatim as evidence. Everything a developer would actually want is behind a partner relationship, a travel-agent registration, or a GDS or channel-manager contract.

providers.name: Hilton
providers.description: Hilton is one of the largest and fastest-growing hospitality companies in the world, with a portfolio of hotel brands across luxury, full-service, focused-service, and timeshare segments. Hilton operates a developer program that exposes APIs for hotel search, availability, reservations, loyalty program integration, and partner distribution. Most Hilton APIs are partner-gated and require credentials issued through the Hilton developer program.

providers.name: Wynn Resorts
providers.description: Wynn Resorts is a developer, owner, and operator of integrated luxury resorts and casinos, with properties in Las Vegas, Boston Harbor, and Macau. The company does not currently publish a public developer portal or API documentation.

providers.name: Caesars Entertainment
providers.description: Caesars Entertainment is the largest U.S. casino-entertainment company, operating over 50 gaming facilities, hotels, restaurants, and entertainment venues across the country and internationally. The company operates the Caesars Rewards loyalty program and offers gaming, hospitality, dining, entertainment, meetings and conventions, and retail experiences.

providers.name: Las Vegas Sands
providers.description: Las Vegas Sands Corp. is the world's leading developer and operator of integrated resorts, including The Venetian Resort in Las Vegas (divested in 2022) and Marina Bay Sands in Singapore. The company operates in the casino, hospitality, convention, and entertainment industries.

providers.name: Carnival Corporation
providers.description: Carnival Corporation & plc is the world's largest cruise company operating eight cruise line brands (Carnival Cruise Line, Princess Cruises, Holland America Line, Seabourn, Cunard, P&O Cruises, Costa Cruises, AIDA Cruises), plus the White Pass and Yukon Route. Carnival operates the OceanMedallion wearable IoT technology and mobile experience platform, the Carnival HUB app, the Princess MedallionClass app, and a portfolio of guest-facing digital experiences across its fleet of over 90 ships.

providers.name: Avis Budget
providers.description: Avis Budget Group is a leading global provider of vehicle rental and mobility solutions with brands including Avis, Budget, Budget Truck, Payless, and Zipcar.

providers.name: Royal Caribbean Group
providers.description: Royal Caribbean Group is a global cruise vacation company operating Royal Caribbean International, Celebrity Cruises, and Silversea Cruises. Royal Caribbean does not publish a public developer API. Travel partner and agent integration is operated through the CruisingPower B2B portal (cruisingpower.com), which requires authenticated agent access. The company also operates loyalty (Crown & Anchor Society) and consumer booking platforms with no public API surface.

providers.name: Hyatt Hotels
providers.description: Hyatt Hotels Corporation is a global hospitality company managing a portfolio of hotel, resort, and residential brands. This repository tracks public APIs, developer resources, and integration touchpoints associated with Hyatt Hotels.

providers.name: MGM Resorts International
providers.description: MGM Resorts International is a global entertainment company with national and international locations featuring best-in-class hotels and casinos, state-of-the-art meetings and conference spaces, and dining and entertainment venues. This repository captures the APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable API artifacts for MGM Resorts International.

providers.name: Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings
providers.description: Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings Ltd. (NYSE: NCLH) is a global cruise company operating three premium brands: Norwegian Cruise Line (pioneer of Freestyle Cruising), Oceania Cruises, and Regent Seven Seas Cruises. The company operates a combined fleet of more than 30 ships sailing to over 700 destinations worldwide. No public developer portal or external API offering has been identified for Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings; travel agent and global distribution system (GDS) integrations are handled through contracted partner programs rather than a self-serve developer API.

providers.name: Loews Corporation
providers.description: Loews Corporation is a diversified holding company with subsidiaries operating in commercial property and casualty insurance (CNA Financial), natural gas pipelines (Boardwalk Pipelines), packaging products (Altium Packaging), and hotels (Loews Hotels). Loews Corporation does not currently publish a public developer API or developer portal; this index tracks the company website and consumer-facing properties for reference.

providers.name: Boyd Gaming
providers.description: Boyd Gaming is a multi-jurisdictional casino entertainment company that owns and operates 28+ gaming properties across 10 U.S. states. The company offers casino gaming, hotel accommodations, dining, entertainment, and sports betting through its Boyd Sports platform. Boyd Rewards is the company's loyalty program spanning all properties, accessible via web portal and mobile app.

providers.name: Host Hotels & Resorts
providers.description: Host Hotels & Resorts is a leading lodging real estate investment trust (REIT) that owns luxury and upper-upscale hotels operating under premium brands in major U.S. and international markets. No public APIs are offered.

providers.name: VICI Properties
providers.description: VICI Properties is an experiential real estate investment trust (REIT) that owns one of the largest portfolios of gaming, hospitality, and entertainment destinations in the United States, including Caesars Palace and the Venetian Resort Las Vegas. The company holds long-term triple-net leases with leading gaming operators. No public developer API or developer portal has been identified; VICI engages investors and partners through corporate and investor relations channels.

providers.name: Hyatt
providers.description: A global hospitality company managing and franchising luxury and upscale hotels, resorts, and vacation properties. Operates brands including Park Hyatt, Grand Hyatt, Andaz, and Hyatt Regency across more than 70 countries. No public developer portal or open API catalogue was located; Hyatt distributes inventory through GDS and travel-industry channels rather than a public REST API surface.

providers.name: Wyndham Worldwide
providers.description: Wyndham Worldwide Corporation was a global hospitality holding company that offered hotel franchising, vacation ownership, and exchange services. On May 31, 2018, it completed the spin-off of its hotel business as Wyndham Hotels & Resorts, Inc. (NYSE: WH) and the remaining vacation ownership and exchange business was renamed Wyndham Destinations, Inc. (NYSE: WYND), which was later renamed Travel + Leisure Co. (NYSE: TNL) on February 17, 2021. Wyndham Worldwide no longer exists as an operating entity.
